name: Bajju
description: The Bajju people are known for farming, vibrant cloth weaving, and the annual Afan yam festival.

name: Atyap
description: The Atyap community around Zangon Kataf preserves music, dance, and local history through storytelling.

name: Agworok (Kagoro)
description: Agworok people live near the Kagoro Hills and are known for their craft, communal ceremonies, and hillside farming.

name: Irigwe
description: The Irigwe people blend storytelling, carving, and farming traditions in a region rich with community ritual.
